evidence_required: FT-002-AC-006 RED: no authorized staff page exposes truthful processing/recovery and separate primary-store capacity; GREEN: Playwright CLI operator/developer flows render current queue/failure/recovery plus independent normal/low/unavailable PostgreSQL and MinIO states, preserve the empty SLO interval as no numeric ratio/verdict, refresh after five seconds, deny photographer access and reveal no protected markers; decisive comparison: rendered values match API/provider state and credential/auth/path/key/embedding/model/media scans remain empty across DOM, URL, trace and logs; artifact: Playwright CLI transcript, screenshots/trace, redacted topology/log scan and disposable cleanup record.
purpose: Complete the authorized operational health outcome through the existing plain staff web surface and real-browser proof.
success_outcome: An operator/developer can see truthful processing failures/recovery and distinct current PostgreSQL/MinIO capacity, including low/unavailable states, while protected infrastructure/media details remain absent.
anti_goals: Do not add a frontend framework, dashboard platform, metrics history, alerts, WebSocket/SSE, photographer access or diagnostics detail.
Do not expose paths, keys, credentials, authentication state, embeddings, model assets or commercial media.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
Production credentials, data, mounted volume contents or browser access to private services
UI-owned lifecycle, SLO or capacity calculations
stop_conditions: The existing same-origin staff page cannot render the exact API without a new UI/runtime framework.
Real-browser proof cannot use isolated disposable state or would require exposing protected production infrastructure.

constraints: Extend the existing plain staff surface and poll the exact API every five seconds.
Use the installed Playwright CLI through `playwright cli`; browser-free HTTP/DOM probes are not substitutes for UAT.
Use disposable operator/developer/photographer and normal/low/unavailable/recovery fixtures with safe rerun and complete cleanup.
invariants: Photographers cannot open the health view; operator/developer see only bounded operational facts.
PostgreSQL and MinIO remain separate even when one is unavailable.
No protected marker appears in rendered text, DOM attributes, URLs, screenshots, trace or application logs.
verification_targets: Playwright CLI UAT covers operator/developer success, photographer denial, processing failure/recovery, the empty SLO interval without a numeric ratio/verdict, each store normal/low/unavailable independently and five-second refresh; store transcript, screenshots and trace under the task artifact directory.
Redaction/private-topology scan covers rendered DOM, URLs, browser trace, responses and application logs with task-owned synthetic markers.
